results.text: No—not just because it took 40 seconds. That shot tasted great, and 40 seconds is a guide, not a failure threshold; keep the dose and output unless the flavor worsens. The sour-and-bitter gusher is a separate concern: uneven preparation or channeling can produce both, so improve distribution and tamp consistency before changing grind. Judge the next shot by sweetness, balance, and whether it sprays—not time alone.
